name: Asakura Otome
source:
In Graduation days:
This is Otome after graduating from Kazami School. Through various painful events of suffering from a magician's fate, she now lives her days together with [url=/c4059]Yoshiyuki[/url] and her friends, which are filled with happiness. She is totally in love with Yoshiyuki, and both of them are very intimitate.

In Married life:
Blessed by her friends and relatives from Kazami School, Otome now lives a happy, married life her husband, Yoshiyuki. Their relationship is very sweet, to the point where even [url=/c34291]Yume[/url] said "just by looking at the two, you can feel sugar falling from your mouth just like drool."

In Dear to...:
Yoshiyuki's dear wife. Their sweet love life hasn't changed ever since the day they were married. According to Yume, their relationship nowadays looks more like "a chocolate pancake topped with ice cream and bucketful of honey."

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=834265]Getchu[/url]]
